messages:
ana: opened a tiny PR to clarify SOC2 audit-log export language, add a short redaction failure example, and fix a broken CLI anchor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/541
mike: thanks. please state explicitly that exports don't change tenant TTLs and that only Org Admins / Compliance role can request exports or modify retention. auditors asked for that phrasing.
ana: added sentence: 'Exports are immutable snapshots and do not modify the configured retention TTL; only Organization Admins and users with the Compliance role may request exports, legal holds, or change retention settings.'
legal: wording fine. replace 'permanent' with 'indefinite' if used, and link to internal retention policy: https://internal/legal/retention-policy. also add one-line legal-hold workflow.
ana: switched to 'indefinite' and added: 'Legal holds suspend deletion until released by Legal; hold actions are recorded in the audit trail.' added link.
mike: can we include a short Ruby SDK error example when redaction isn't enabled? customers asked about this failure mode.
nana: added Ruby snippet and the minimal error body:
```ruby
# Ruby export + redaction request
client.export_audit_logs(tenant_id: 'acme', start: '2024-01-01', end: '2024-01-31', redact_pii: true)
# example error -> 422 {"error":"redaction_not_enabled","message":"PII redaction not configured for tenant"}
```
legal: good. also add a short note that export requests are logged with requester.id.
nana: added note. docbot: PR 541 updated, link-check passed, staging build OK.
nana: planning to merge tomorrow unless any objections :thumbsup:
